title: Quantum Large Language Models via Tensor Network Disentanglers
abstract: arXiv:2410.17397v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a framework for seamlessly integrating quantum computing into pretrained large language models (LLMs). The key idea is to construct a hybrid quantum-classical representation that exactly reproduces the original model, providing a principled starting point from which quantum resources can only improve performance. Our approach replaces the weight matrices in self-attention and multilayer perceptron layers with two variational quantum circuits coupled to a matrix product operator (MPO). Tensor network disentanglers transfer much of each layer's information into the quantum circuits, enabling the remaining tensor network to be compressed to a bond-dimension-one MPO with over three orders of magnitude fewer classical parameters (in our experiments, from 110,592 to approximately 36 for the replaced layer) and less than a 0.3\% increase in perplexity. tldr: 本文提出一种混合量子-经典框架，通过张量网络解纠缠器将量子电路集成到预训练大语言模型中，在保持性能（困惑度增加<0.3%）的同时，将经典参数压缩超过三个数量级。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a hybrid quantum-classical framework that integrates quantum circuits into pretrained LLMs via tensor network disentanglers, compressing classical parameters by over three orders of magnitude while maintaining performance (perplexity increase <0.3%).
